svg.desc: Stacked step area of the number of states holding each counterspace capability per decade, zero baseline. See the data table for exact counts.

text.tspan: Electronic warfare drives most of the crowding: 12 states in the 2020s.
Demonstrated destructive DA-ASAT capability has stayed at four states: US, China, USSR/Russia, India.

svg.text: Chart B · Capability diffusion. Data: ledger built from SWF Global Counterspace Capabilities (9th ed., Apr. 2026) and cited sources. Companion to Space Security Law.
